settings.title: About Apex Feeds
settings.text:
At Apex Feeds we believe reptiles, amphibians, invertebrates, and other exotic animals deserve nutrition that reflects what nature intended.

Founded by passionate reptile keeper and breeder James Bindoff, Apex Feeds draws on over 15 years of industry knowledge, from private keeper all the way to pet store owner and pet product wholesaling.
